correctness.rationale: PASS: In T_n=L(K_n), a selected edge set S initially observes every K_n edge touching an S endpoint, leaving only edges among isolated vertices U; if |U|≤2 one forcing step completes, while |U|≥3 no observed edge has a unique unobserved neighbor. Minimal successful S are a one-isolate matching (odd n) or two-isolate star forest. The exponential formula counts each labeled star/matching minimal set and inclusion-exclusion counts all valid sets. The TAR proof connects every smaller minimal configuration by bounded add-then-delete exchanges, first reducing large stars to minimum matchings and then connecting exposed-label matchings with one spare edge, while minimal sets at current maximum budget k are isolated. This yields c_n(q_n)=m_n,q_n, c_n(k)=1+m_n,k for q_n<k≤n−3, and c_n(k)=1 for k≥n−2. Independent direct power-domination and TAR graph BFS checks for n=4,5,6 reproduced every budget profile through n−2.
